title: drive_parity re-applies the already-fast-path-applied action log through pp.step (double-apply); goldens pin a state the app never produces
detail: Every logged command was already applied by the executor's fast-path; step re-applies them. Probe of the exact sequence: draw scenario ends with 2 parallel pipes (app: 1); demolish re-creates a phantom live pipe and latches replay_error. Cross-device equality survives (all devices share it), but the blessed input_parity goldens pin a trajectory the live game never reaches.
recommended_fix: Step with an empty batch — pp.step(&state, sim_tick, {}, cat) — mirroring app/main.odin:303 (edits already landed via the fast-path); then re-bless input_parity_draw{,_wide}.t1.

title: esc_press 'B2 pin' cannot observe the Press_Anchor swallow-latch ordering it claims to pin — the scripted release never reads press_swallowed
detail: The scripted press lands on a node (drag starts) and the release moved >6px: Drag_Release/commit_draw never consult press_swallowed; only Select does, and this script emits no Select. Deleting the Press_Anchor emission keeps all 17 scenarios green — the latch half of the B2 fix is unpinned (only placing_eff is).
recommended_fix: Add a non-moved variant: same-frame [ESC + press on a pipe], release at the same point — the old code's Select re-selects the pipe only when the press reset the latch; assert sel_pipe to pin Press_Anchor's ordering.

title: reject scenario's selection guard uses && — only fails when BOTH sel_node and sel_pipe changed, weaker than its comment
detail: The comment promises 'a rejected draw must not change the selection', but the guard fires only when both fields changed; a regression (or mapping asymmetry) that sets exactly one of sel_node/sel_pipe passes the pin silently.
recommended_fix: Change the condition to r.sel_node != -1 || r.sel_pipe != -1 (or two per-field asserts).

title: run_input_parity's cleanup frees each frame slice but never the per-device [dynamic] script arrays returned by frames()
detail: The defer deletes each evs() frame backing, sc.expected, and scenarios, but not sc.mouse/sc.touch/sc.pad themselves — ~40 small dynamic-array backings leak at process exit. The harness installs no tracking allocator, so it is invisible; process-lifetime bounded.
recommended_fix: Add delete(sc.mouse); delete(sc.touch); delete(sc.pad) alongside delete(sc.expected) in the same defer.

title: input-parity verb silently ignores extra/unknown arguments (unlike sibling verbs that enforce arity)
detail: `harness input-parity junk` runs the check and `input-parity save junk` re-blesses, with no usage error; replay/stats-check/overlay-check all validate len(rest). A typo'd flag is silently treated as check mode.
recommended_fix: Guard: if len(rest) > 1 || (len(rest) == 1 && rest[0] != "save") { usage() } before dispatching run_input_parity.

title: A scenario with all three device scripts empty passes vacuously (zero-device case unguarded)
detail: With zero participating devices, check_scenario returns green with no comparisons, check_states' find misses every device, and the scenario counts toward 'green'. Latent today (all 17 scenarios drive ≥1 device), but a scenario-authoring slip would pass silently.
recommended_fix: In run_input_parity, append a failure when len(devs) == 0 (a scenario must drive at least one device).
